import json, sys, statistics
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / "tools/qbe"))
from verify_public_int import run, digest
root = Path.cwd()
build = root / "build/qbe-float-controls"
compiler = root / "build/qbe-port-tools/native-selfhost/frontend-stage3"
backend = root / "build/qbe-port-tools/native-selfhost/qbe-stage3"
baseline = root / "build/qbe/compiler-baseline"
report = {"complete": False, "baseline_sha256": digest(baseline), "compiler_sha256": digest(compiler), "backend_sha256": digest(backend), "runtime_sha256": digest(root / "build/qbe/runtime.o"), "builds": [], "controls": [], "known_failures": [], "large_il": [], "isolated_performance": {}}
path = build / "verification.json"
def save(): path.write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2) + "\n")
def checked(cmd):
 r = run(cmd, timeout=180); report["builds"].append(r); save()
 assert r["returncode"] == 0 and not r["timed_out"], r
 return r
try:
 for name in ("native_float_arithmetic", "native_float_boundaries", "native_float_effects"):
  source = root / "tests/qbe" / (name + ".lsl"); output = build / (name + "-baseline")
  checked([baseline, source, output, backend]); r = run([output]); r.update(source=str(source.relative_to(root)), source_sha256=digest(source), expected=source.with_suffix(".out").read_text())
  r["matches"] = r["returncode"] == 0 and r["stdout"] == r["expected"]; report["controls"].append(r); save(); assert r["matches"], r
 source = build / "preexisting-gaps.lsl"
 source.write_text("array = FloatArray([1.5,2.5])\nprint __lsl_float_bits(array[0]) == __lsl_float_bits(1.5)\nprint __lsl_float_bits(array[1]) == __lsl_float_bits(2.5)\nprint (9007199254740993 + 1) + 0.0 == 9007199254740994.0\n")
 report["known_failure_source"] = source.read_text()
 for kind, front in (("baseline",baseline),("candidate",compiler)):
  output = build / ("preexisting-gaps-" + kind); checked([front,source,output,backend]); r = run([output]); r["kind"] = kind; r["expected_correct_language_output"] = "True\nTrue\nTrue\n"; r["status"] = "KNOWN_BASELINE_FAILURE"
  report["known_failures"].append(r); save(); assert r["returncode"] == 0 and r["stdout"] == "False\nFalse\n1\n",r
 bench = json.loads((root / "tests/qbe_port/comparison-v089-after-float-perf-linux-x86_64.json").read_text())
 row = next(x for x in bench["workloads"] if x["name"] == "float_loop"); count = row["iterations"]; expected = row["expected_stdout"]
 outputs = {"base_4f730f7": root / "build/qbe-float-profile/float-baseline", "candidate": root / "build/qbe-port-tools/v089-comparison/float_loop-qbe_lsl", "v089": root / "build/qbe-port-tools/v089-comparison/float_loop-v089"}
 perf = report["isolated_performance"]; perf.update(iterations=count, expected_stdout=expected, source=row["source"], source_sha256=row["source_sha256"], samples=[], binaries={k:{"path":str(v),"sha256":digest(v)} for k,v in outputs.items()}, repeats=7, timing="serialized alternating process wall-clock; medians; production executables without counters")
 for repeat in range(7):
  order = list(outputs) if repeat % 2 == 0 else list(reversed(outputs))
  for kind in order:
   r=run([outputs[kind],count]);r.update(kind=kind,repeat=repeat,checksum_matches=r["stdout"]==expected);perf["samples"].append(r);save();assert r["returncode"]==0 and r["checksum_matches"],r
 perf["median_seconds"]={kind:statistics.median(r["seconds"] for r in perf["samples"] if r["kind"]==kind) for kind in outputs}
 perf["candidate_over_base"] = perf["median_seconds"]["candidate"] / perf["median_seconds"]["base_4f730f7"]
 perf["candidate_over_v089"] = perf["median_seconds"]["candidate"] / perf["median_seconds"]["v089"]
 for name in ("frontend", "backend"):
  source=Path("/home/antonin/LSL-QBE/build/qbe-port-tools") / ("bench-input-" + name + ".ssa")
  row={"input":str(source),"source_sha256":digest(source),"outputs":{}}
  for kind,exe in (("reference",root / "build/qbe/qbe"),("candidate",backend)):
   output=build / (name + "-" + kind + ".s");checked([exe,"-o",output,source]);row["outputs"][kind]=digest(output)
  row["matches"]=len(set(row["outputs"].values())) == 1;report["large_il"].append(row);save();assert row["matches"],row
 report["complete"] = True
except Exception as error: report["error"] = str(error)
save()
print("PASS" if report["complete"] else "FAIL", path, report.get("error", ""), flush=True)
sys.exit(0 if report["complete"] else 1)
